title: Nuevo Laredo's 'Mineraliza tu Ganado' program aims for 40 tons of minerals for 200-plus ranchers
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo's municipal government is subsidizing 75% of the cost of cattle mineral supplements, projecting 40 tons delivered to more than 200 producers by year's end.
content:
Nuevo Laredo's municipal government is pushing a program called "Mineraliza tu Ganado" that subsidizes 75% of the cost of mineral supplements for cattle feed, with a projection of 40 tons delivered to more than 200 producers by the end of the year, according to CML Noticias.

Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal said the strategy is meant to lower costs for ranching families and strengthen livestock activity in Nuevo Laredo. The city covers 75% of the mineral cost while ranchers pay the remaining 25%, making supplements that support animal nutrition and health easier to obtain.

Progress on the program was presented at the Rastro Municipal, where the mayor said her administration keeps a policy of closeness with rural producers, supporting them with aid that meets their needs and favors the local economy.

Through the Rural Development office, the city is also carrying out other livestock support, including free ivermectin application for parasite control and testing for bovine tuberculosis and brucellosis, aimed at preventing disease and strengthening animal health.

Further programs in the works include genetic improvement of cattle, acquisition of registered bulls and heifers, livestock infrastructure, and drought-season feeding alternatives such as the gas-for-chamusque program. Related efforts also reach other rural sectors, including beekeeping.

Sources:

  • CML Noticias, "Nuevo Laredo proyecta entregar 40 toneladas de minerales a través del programa 'Mineraliza tu Ganado,'" October 30, 2026
